subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Ler e compreender, em colaboração com os colegas e com a ajuda do professor, cartazes, avisos, folhetos, regras e regulamentos que organizam a vida na comunidade escolar, dentre outros gêneros do campo da atuação cidadã, considerando a situação comunicativa e o tema/assunto do texto.

components.description_pt: Ler e compreender colaborativamente cartazes e avisos que organizam a vida da comunidade escolar
components.description_en: Read and comprehend collaboratively posters and notices that organize school community life
components.cc_component_description: Read and comprehend grade 6–8 literary nonfiction texts independently and proficiently

components.description_pt: Ler e compreender colaborativamente panfletos, regras e regulamentações do campo de participação cívica
components.description_en: Read and comprehend collaboratively flyers, rules, and regulations from the civic participation field
components.cc_component_description: Read and comprehend grade 6–8 literary nonfiction texts independently and proficiently

components.description_pt: Identificar situação comunicativa e tema abordado em gêneros de participação cívica
components.description_en: Identify the communicative situation and topic addressed in civic-participation genres
components.cc_component_description: Identify the topic and purpose of a social studies argument

cc_matches.description: By the end of the year, read and comprehend literary nonfiction in the grades 6—8 text complexity band proficiently, with scaffolding as needed at the high end of the range.

Multilingual learners will interpret social studies arguments by
* Identifying topic and purpose *(argue in favor or against a position, present a balanced interpretation, challenge perspective)*
* Analyzing relevant information from multiple sources __to support claims__
* Evaluating point of view and credibility of source based __on relevance and intended use__
